reader.requirement: In a relative file control entry the SELECT clause must come first and the clauses after it (ASSIGN, RESERVE, ORGANIZATION, ACCESS MODE with its RELATIVE KEY phrase, FILE STATUS) must be accepted, and take effect, in any order; the RELATIVE KEY is a phrase of the ACCESS MODE clause at 1985, not a clause of its own, so it cannot be moved on its own.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.RelativeKeyClauseAlone2002 (COBOL0900): below 2002, a RELATIVE KEY clause not directly after the ACCESS MODE clause is refused; at 2002 and later it is a clause of its own

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Constructs/ConstructRegistry in FileControlBinder.cs and the fileControlClauseGroup/fileControlClauses rules; the grammar (SELECT first, then fileControlClauses* in any order) and the binder's clause loop are edition-free. The only edition arm is the RELATIVE KEY placement gate.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 1985 RELATIVE KEY must follow ACCESS MODE as its phrase (refused standing alone, COBOL0900); at 2023 the same entry compiles and runs. The any-order rule for the clauses themselves is the same at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness uses indexed and sequential entries; the relative entry in reverse order, the bare RELATIVE organization word, RESERVE first, and the separated RELATIVE KEY phrase were not exercised

reader.notes: The grammar requires SELECT first and admits fileControlClauses* in any order; the binder reads each clause wherever it is written, and the relative probe shows every clause taking effect in reverse order. The 1985-only constraint that RELATIVE KEY is a phrase of ACCESS MODE has its own edition arm in VersionConformancePass, so moving the phrase away is refused at 85 and accepted at 2023.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VIII.2.3.2 format (RELATIVE KEY only as a phrase of ACCESS MODE; RANDOM/DYNAMIC require it) and 2.3.3 SR1. Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-065: r1a (RELATIVE KEY after ACCESS MODE but separated by FILE STATUS) refused COBOL0900 'not a phrase of the ACCESS MODE clause requires COBOL-2002'; r1b (ACCESS RANDOM, no key) refused COBOL0863; r1c (2002 LOCK MODE, SHARING refused COBOL0900; RECORD DELIMITER on relative refused COBOL2912); r1d (ORGANIZATION and ACCESS each written twice) refused COBOL2423; r1e (SELECT OPTIONAL, then FILE STATUS, RESERVE 3 AREAS, ACCESS RANDOM RELATIVE KEY RK with noise words dropped, ASSIGN, bare RELATIVE last) ran: OPEN=05 / INV / READ=23, every clause in effect. r6a also accepted 'RELATIVE ACCESS DYNAMIC RELATIVE RKD' with optional words omitted. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.2.3.3 SR1 (2.3.3 Syntax Rules) the text is in SR1.
